neighbours.label: the final syllable piece ('mi', 'umi', 'i') of a romanized Japanese or Sanskrit name (Ohsum|i, U|mi, Bh|umi)
fire: The Nobel lecture was given by Yoshinori Ohsumi in Stockholm.
We drove along the coast toward Umi no Nakamichi park.
Farmers in the village celebrate Bhumi Puja every spring.
My classmate Kasumi moved to Osaka after graduation.
The novel follows a young carpenter named Takumi.
The singer Natsumi released a new album last month.
Our tour guide in Kyoto was a woman called Izumi.
The poem was dedicated to her friend Kazumi.
